title: See every label and how it's used
summary: Page through all the labels on your Jira site, filter them, and count how many issues use each one.
caption: Duplicate spellings of the same label, with issue counts.

title: Merge duplicates with a preview
summary: Rename, merge or remove labels across every issue. Preview exactly how many issues will change first.
caption: Merging three spellings of "frontend" into one, previewed before running.

title: Run safely, undo if needed
summary: Changes run in small batches you can stop at any time. A journal keeps recent runs so you can undo them.
caption: A completed merge across 136 issues in the journal, ready to undo.
